flags.summary: April 2026: Mirror Indy reported that a Williams campaign mailer for the May 5 primary, captioned "Your official Democratic team!" with an "Official candidates" stamp, was criticized as implying Marion County Democratic Party backing the party no longer gives; opponent Gregory Patrick called it a "last-minute trick" and several listed candidates said they had not been consulted. The mailer carried a disclaimer that only Williams's campaign paid for and approved it. Williams did not respond to Mirror Indy; the outlet said he told IndyStar he had permission from the other candidates, then retracted that. No formal consequence was reported.
flags.note: Campaign-conduct criticism from a rival and others; IndyStar interview not read directly.

sources.title: Marion County sheriff's candidate accused of 'shady tactics'

flags.summary: August 2024: Southport Mayor Jim Cooney removed Vaughn as police chief, saying Vaughn had not provided documents the mayor requested and that the decision was not political; Vaughn told Fox59 he believed the removal was unjust and followed a complaint he had filed about the mayor's involvement in a city property inspection. After more than 100 residents rallied in support, the two met and Cooney reinstated Vaughn days later .
flags.note: Resolved by reinstatement; IndyPolitics also mentions it. Terms of the agreement were not reported in the pages read.

sources.title: Southport police chief reinstated after discord with mayor
